company_info.description: Life Intelligent Enterprise Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the alcoholic beverage, education, food, and other businesses in Japan. The company is involved in the retail discount of commercial food products; engages in the wholesale of meat; real estate business; renovation-related business; and employment support and other welfare services, as well as operates a nickel business. It also manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages, such as shochu under the Enma; ENMA; Kojiya Denbei; Sansui; and Rien brand name; and provides tests and teaching materials, videos, and video lessons for junior high schools. In addition, it provides individuals and group travel; and non-life and life insurance agency businesses. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
